semantic.input_block: hy_small = frozen CodeT5-small mean-pooled code embedding (512-d), from r0 corpus cache row = gmodel_idx*nT*2 + task_idx*2 + 1 (instruct)
semantic.scaler: StandardScaler fit on fold-fit rows (server sklearn)

char_tfidf.fit_scope: fold-fit rows texts only (fold-train-only vocabulary & IDF)
char_tfidf.model: SGDClassifier(loss=log_loss, alpha=1e-6) x seeds(0,1,2), 5 epochs of shuffled partial_fit, batch=4096, seed-local RNG permutation

word_tfidf.vectorizer: TfidfVectorizer(analyzer=word, token_pattern=[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*, ngram_range=(1,3), min_df=1, sublinear_tf=True, lowercase=False)

style_meta.input_block: concat(style 92, meta 10, sizelen 3) = 105-d server static features

fusion.z_stats: per-component mean/std (population, ddof=0) of fold-fit-row scores

component_specs.target: y_fit = 1 iff row member's series == heldout member's series
component_specs.eval_layout: eval member blocks in ASCII-sorted member order; rows within block in sorted dev task order
component_specs.metrics: AUROC ties=0.5; task-macro = mean of per-task AUROC; member-macro = mean over folds; task-cluster bootstrap B=500 seed 20261009 (shared indices)
